description: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here. We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the team Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies. We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world. About the role As a Lead Data Scientist, you'll take on a pivotal, entrepreneurial role, functioning as the technical expert who thrives on complexity and commercial impact. You will be responsible for setting the technical direction and ensuring the high-quality, scalable delivery of our most challenging, high-impact projects. This position combines deep expertise in machine learning with strategic oversight to define project roadmaps, manage technical risk, and architect reliable solutions. Your focus will be on driving innovation, mentoring cross-functional teams, and actively shaping both our technical standards and long-term customer relationships. What you'll be doing: Setting the technical direction for complex, business-critical projects and expertly balancing trade-offs between speed, innovation, and reliability. Designing and implementing reliable, production-grade technical solutions, ensuring comprehensive documentation of architectures and specifications. Defining project problems, developing clear roadmaps, and overseeing end-to-end delivery across multi-disciplinary workstreams. Leading technical scoping and feasibility studies for high-value sales opportunities and strategic customer engagements. Managing relationships and communications with demanding clients, fostering trust and aligning technical solutions with shared long-term commercial goals. Driving the adoption of best practices, shared resources, and robust technical processes across the wider Data Science craft. Mentoring and developing other data scientists and team members, actively contributing to the growth and technical excellence of the organisation. Who we're looking for: You bring depth of expertise in at least one machine learning domain and strong technical breadth across the entire data science landscape. You are a skilled technical leader, proficient in mentoring individuals, managing teams (including other managers), and rolling out impactful tools and workflows. You have proven project management expertise, capable of dividing complex, ill-defined problems into actionable, clearly defined workstreams with timelines you can defend. You are adept at managing ill-defined, high-risk tasks, consistently delivering innovative and practical outcomes under commercial pressure. You possess strong customer leadership skills, able to act as a trusted technical advisor and drive long-term strategic relationships with demanding clients. You excel at cross-functional collaboration, effectively aligning technical strategy with Engineering, Commercial (BD), and Infrastructure teams. You have experience extending technical oversight to business unit-level initiatives, using your vision to influence and contribute to organisational success. Our Interview Process Talent Team Screen (30 minutes) Introduction to the team (45 minutes) Technical Interview (90 minutes) Commercial Interview (60 minutes) Our Recruitment Ethos We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI. description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? Solskin is not just a PV system or a shading system; it’s an intelligent skin that uses weather and building data, occupant feedback, and AI algorithms to decide how the facade moves, so buildings stay comfortable, avoid overheating, and use energy as efficiently as possible. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You write the code that runs Solskin, keep it reliable in the field, and constantly improve it. You will also architect and lead our future sensor-to-data platform. Your focus is where software meets hardware, and the control and AI on top of it. You don't need to be a front-end specialist. What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better. Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next: With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. Our stack: Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch Frontend: React, TypeScript Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB) DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana What we are looking for Required: Education: MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar. Python: This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems. Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems. Cloud & data: You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS. Leadership attitude: You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader. Languages: English. German is a big plus. Hybrid setting: You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products. Availability: 100%, as soon as possible. Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position. Preferred: Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means. Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. Frontend: React and TypeScript. Mindset: Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself. Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you. Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter. Benefits Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work. Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company. Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days. Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out. The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one. Sounds like you? Send us your CV and a short document instead of a classic cover letter. It doesn’t need to be long, just enough for us to understand who you are and where you stand. Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together. Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. Describe a time your work was like that, and how you handled it. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description:
Four models in production today. Fifteen to twenty by mid-2027. The shared pipeline that gets them there has to hold — and you own everything after handoff: packaging, deployment, drift detection, and the call on whether a model is fit to serve.

Location: Central Berlin — you work from our office, hybrid with 3 days office and 2 days home office.

 

About us

CarOnSale is the AI-powered platform for B2B used car trading in Europe. Over 40,000 buyers from more than 20 countries trade on our platform — and 85% of inventory is exclusive to us. We connect software, pricing intelligence, logistics and financing in one layer — as the operating system for an entire industry.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

 

The platform you build in

Our machine learning runs on one shared, central platform — not a separate pipeline per model. Five canonical stages: data extraction, validation, transformation, training and evaluation. A Snowflake data warehouse feeds a SageMaker managed feature store, and models reach production through governed CI/CD promotion lanes on Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure. Your job is to build inside it and make it stronger, so the next model costs less to ship than the last one.

 

Your responsibilities

  • You own models from handoff through to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring, and the decision on whether a model is ready to serve
  • You keep production models reliable — drift detection, performance monitoring, alerting and incident response when something moves
  • You own the serving and inference path: fitted pipeline artifacts, inference entry points, monitoring hooks and feature-store parity
  • You review model design and evaluation methodology before anything ships, and catch data leakage, backward-window errors and weak evaluation during development, while they are still cheap to fix
  • You extend the shared platform so it stays useful for every model, without project-specific logic leaking into shared code
  • You set the engineering standards the platform runs on as it scales across the organisation

 

What you bring

  • 4+ years in production machine learning engineering, with real ownership of models after handoff — not only training them
  • Strong Python: typed, tested, production-grade code, and you review the work of others
  • Enough machine learning depth to challenge a pipeline on problem framing, feature engineering, model selection and evaluation methodology
  • Hands-on experience with a managed ML platform — SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks or Azure ML — plus feature stores, CI/CD for machine learning, AWS and Terraform
  • An AI-native way of working: you use tools like Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot actively in your daily work
  • English at C1 level, written and spoken. German is not required — we work in English

Nice to have

  • Snowflake and dbt — you can pick both up here
  • Experience mentoring colleagues or reviewing their work
  • Comfort operating where the answer is not defined yet

What to expect from us

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in office, 2 days remote – plus 25 "Work from Anywhere" days per year
  • 28 days annual leave
  • 2× annual career & development conversations
  • Company pension with 20% employer contribution
  • Fully paid Deutschlandticket (public transport)
  • FitX membership or Urban Sports Club subsidy
  • Virtual stock options — share in the upside
  • Modern IT setup for your day-to-day work
  • Structured onboarding with buddy programme and social events

Engineering & Chapter Leadership

Vous êtes un(e) leader expérimenté(e) en ingénierie logicielle et en technologie, capable de conjuguer une expertise technique approfondie, une vision architecturale, des compétences en leadership et une forte orientation client.

Capco est un cabinet de conseil international, spécialisé dans les services financiers.

description: About Nous Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute. We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money. We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked. Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent. And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people". The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build. The role What Nous does for members can feel simple: helping them understand their bills, save money, and avoid admin. Delivering that reliably at scale is much harder. You’ll join the Operations team at the heart of the business, working on the difficult real-world problems that sit between our members, our product, external suppliers and the systems that make Nous work. This is not a traditional customer operations role. You’ll spend time close to our members, understanding their questions, investigating things that have gone wrong and learning in detail how our service works. We think that matters: the best systems are usually built by people who have seen the underlying problems first-hand. But we don’t want you simply to get faster at doing manual work. We want you to spot the pattern, understand why the problem exists, and help build a better way of doing it. That might mean redesigning a process, building an automation, using AI to remove repetitive work, querying data to understand what is happening, improving an internal tool, or working with Product and Engineering on a more fundamental fix. You don't need to arrive knowing all of the tools we use. We care much more about how quickly you learn them. We’re looking for someone early in their career who is unusually curious, quick to learn and good at figuring things out. You might already have built automations or small products yourself. You might instead have worked in operations, consulting, product, analytics or another demanding environment and found yourself constantly looking for better ways to do things. Either way, we want someone who gets excited by a problem they don't immediately know how to solve. You’ll have a lot of support from experienced operators, engineers and product people, but also be given a lot of responsibility unusually early in your career. The aim is for you to quickly become someone who can take an undefined operational problem, understand it properly and build a robust solution. It’s a rare chance to learn how a fast-growing technology company actually works from the inside while building the systems that allow it to scale. About you You’re smart, curious, ambitious and unusually high-agency. You don't need a long list of technical tools on your CV. We care much more about how you think, how quickly you learn and what you do when you encounter something you don't understand. You’ll probably thrive here if you: Have roughly 1–3 years of experience in a demanding environment such as a startup, operations, consulting, product, analytics or similar Learn unusually quickly and enjoy tackling problems you haven't seen before Are technically curious and actively experiment with AI and new tools to make yourself more effective Have evidence that you like building things, whether that's automations, side projects, spreadsheets, scripts, internal tools, processes or something completely different Are comfortable getting into the detail and tracing a problem until you understand what is really happening Can take something messy and ambiguous and impose structure on it Are naturally empathetic and enjoy understanding what a customer actually needs Communicate clearly and directly Are comfortable working directly with customers and frontline problems, and see that as a source of insight Take ownership rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do This role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants a steep learning curve, real responsibility and the chance to work as part of a team solving difficult problems. Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Je opereert op het snijvlak van Business en IT en stuurt een Agile Business Team aan dat vraagstukken vertaalt naar waardevolle Epics en Features. Onze strategie is gericht op continue verbetering van Operational Excellence, altijd vanuit klantwaarde, waarbij we processen expliciet koppelen aan de bovenliggende klantreis. Met jouw scherpe prioritering houd je de backlog overzichtelijk, definieer je features en stories en bewaak je de kwaliteit volgens de hoogste standaarden en de Definition of Done. Met jouw scherpe prioriteitenbeheer houd je de backlog overzichtelijk, definieer je features en stories en bewaak je de kwaliteit van opgeleverde producten, altijd volgens de hoogste standaarden en de Definition of Done. Je brengt focus in het team, stimuleert samenwerking en zorgt voor energie tijdens demo's en retrospectives. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat nieuwe vereisten en proposities tijdig en correct worden doorgevoerd in alle relevante systemen, van administratie tot klantcommunicatie, zodat de klantreis over alle kanalen consistent en effectief is ingericht. Hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau met analytisch vermogen om complexe processen snel te doorgronden Passie voor de Pensioen Business en affiniteit met domeinkennis (o.a. description:
About the Role

At Agile Robots, we build intelligent robotic systems that learn from high-quality real-world data. To keep our data collection site running at full capacity, we are looking for a Robot Service Engineer (m/f/d) who keeps our robots, teleoperation devices and recording systems operational every day.

In this role, you will be the first technical contact on site. You will diagnose and fix hardware and software issues, maintain the robot fleet, and work closely with our R&D teams to resolve deeper technical problems quickly. Your work directly determines how much usable data the site can produce.

This position is ideal for someone with a hands-on technical mindset who enjoys troubleshooting, works systematically, and wants to grow with cutting-edge robotics and AI technology.

Your Responsibilities

  • On-site Technical Support
    • Provide daily first-line technical support for robots, teleoperation devices, cameras and data recording systems on site.
    • Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network and calibration issues to minimize downtime.
    • Support teleoperators and project coordinators with technical questions during data collection.
  • Maintenance & System Setup
    • Install, set up and calibrate robots and teleoperation workstations for new tasks.
    • Perform preventive maintenance, replace parts and keep the robot fleet in working condition.
    • Maintain records of faults, repairs and spare parts usage.
  • R&D Collaboration & Issue Resolution
    • Escalate complex issues to R&D with clear reproduction steps, logs and data.
    • Test and deploy software updates, fixes and new features on site, and give feedback on results.
    • Identify recurring problems and propose improvements to hardware, software and workflows.
  • Safety & Documentation
    • Ensure robots and equipment are operated in line with safety and operational guidelines.
    • Write and update troubleshooting guides, SOPs and setup instructions for the site team.

Essential Skills

  • Degree or vocational training in mechatronics, electrical engineering, robotics, computer science or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting electromechanical systems, robots or industrial equipment.
  • Basic knowledge of Linux, command line tools and reading system logs.
  • Structured, independent way of working with strong attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills in English; able to explain technical issues clearly to engineers and non-technical colleagues.

Beneficial Skills

  • Experience with robotic arms, ROS/ROS 2, or teleoperation systems.
  • Scripting skills in Python or Bash.
  • Knowledge of cameras, sensors, networking or data pipelines.
  • Experience in field service, technical support or a production / lab environment.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. 

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

description: Hi, I'm Serhii, I'm the Accounting Team Lead at WeTravel, and I'm hiring the Senior Accountant to take over the work I've done for the past three years. I joined as a Junior Accountant, took on this scope early, and grew into leading the accounting team. That path is real here: if you own your work and keep improving how it gets done, scope follows. You'll report to me, and I'll be your day-to-day partner, reviewer and someone to think problems through with. How we work We're a small team, so your work is visible and your ideas get used. We value autonomy: you get clear ownership, not a checklist and someone looking over your shoulder. We care about the "how" as much as the "what." We write standard operating procedures (SOPs), build reusable workpapers, script repetitive NetSuite tasks and use AI tools daily to move faster. If you've ever rebuilt a reconciliation so the next month took half the time, you'll fit in. We're remote-first. Our finance team works mostly from home, split between Amsterdam and the US, so you'll collaborate across time zones. You and I will meet at our Amsterdam office for in-person days, such as working sessions, close kick-offs and planning. How often depends on what the work needs, and we keep it flexible. The office is open every day if you'd rather work from there. You'll need to live in the Netherlands, within reach of Amsterdam. Our values: • Be Respectful: we build an inclusive team that values different perspectives. • Be Honest: we default to transparency, including when something in the numbers is wrong. • Be Resourceful: we find a way forward even when the path isn't mapped out. • Be the Solution: spotting a problem is the start; fixing it is the job. What you'll own You'll own these areas end to end, from monthly entries through audit support. • Month-end close: you'll be the main preparer of the monthly close, owning accruals, prepaids and balance sheet reconciliations, and reviewing the income statement for accuracy, correct periods and department mapping before it goes to final review. • Cash: bank, card and payment-platform accounts across multiple currencies and entities, including Stripe, Airwallex, ING and Corpay. • Intercompany: intercompany entries and loan agreements with interest between entities. • Leases and fixed assets: lease accounting (right-of-use assets and liabilities), leasehold improvements, fixed assets, intangibles and depreciation. • Compensation: bonus and commission accruals, payroll journal entries and liabilities, pension and 401(k). • Expenses and AP: the full expense cycle, from vendor bills and card spend to prepaid amortization, AP tie-outs and department mapping. • VAT: preparing BV VAT returns for review. • Audits: owning your areas in the annual financial audit and tax reviews. • Process: documenting and improving what you own, from standard operating procedures (SOPs) to automation. • Reporting: presenting your areas to the finance team in a weekly review. We care most about how you work, then what you know. Audit firm or in-house, scale-up or corporate: your background matters less than what you've owned. Why You Should or Shouldn't Apply You should apply if you have: • A track record of owning close areas end to end without needing someone to drive them. • 3+ years in accounting, with hands-on month-end close experience. • Multi-entity and multi-currency experience, including intercompany. • Solid grounding in accrual accounting; US GAAP experience, or the willingness to get there quickly alongside Dutch GAAP. • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and experience with a mid-market ERP (NetSuite ideal). • Fluent English, written and spoken. • A bachelor's degree in accounting or finance, or equivalent experience. Nice-to-haves • NetSuite and Ramp experience. • Dutch VAT or statutory reporting exposure. • Examples of processes you've automated or documented, with or without AI tools. • Interest in growing your scope and responsibilities over time. You shouldn't apply if: • You prefer a role where every process is fully documented and never changes. • You need regular check-ins to keep month-end tasks moving. • You'd rather flag a problem than dig in and propose a fix. • You're uncomfortable explaining your numbers, or saying when you got something wrong. Work remotely for a maximum of 4 weeks per calendar year. 2-week cross-functional onboarding program. Cycle-to-work scheme (Swapfiets subscription) or commuting reimbursement. Monday and Thursday lunches and after-work social events. Beautiful office in central Amsterdam – rooftop garden Extensive paid family leave. Three paid volunteer days per year — take time to give back to causes you care about, on us. Cutting-edge equipment and tools to set you up for success. Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation. Employer-sponsored pension plan with a 2% employer contribution deposited into your individual pension account. Access to a 10% group discount on supplementary/additional health insurance (aanvullende verzekeringen), with the same discount available to eligible family members. Access to our Booking Marketplace: Book hotels and flights for personal travel at exclusive discounted rates. Equal Opportunities WeTravel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe you're a good fit, we encourage you to apply and join us in transforming the travel industry! Wie jij bent Je bent geen typische verkoper. Je bent een ondernemende verbinder: iemand die nieuwe kansen ziet, deuren durft te openen en mensen en organisaties oprecht wil begrijpen. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Je haalt energie uit het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en hebt het doorzettingsvermogen dat daarbij hoort; Je hebt een intrinsieke drive om bij te dragen aan betere zorg door digitalisering; Je bent nieuwsgierig en leergierig: de wereld van zorg en ICT blijft je boeien en je houdt je kennis actief bij; Je bent een echte teamspeler en zet het gezamenlijke resultaat boven je eigen ego; Je beschikt over een actief netwerk bij zorgorganisaties, bij voorkeur op het niveau van CIO, CMIO, IM-management of bestuur; Je hebt een trackrecord in het binnenhalen van nieuwe klanten en kent de inkoop- en aanbestedingsprocessen in de zorg; Onze harde eisen voor deze functie Je bent meer een New Business Accountmanager dan een Key Acccountmanager Je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring in de verkoop van dienstverlening, zoals consultancy, interim of detachering; Je hebt minimaal twee jaar recente ervaring met het verkopen van dienstverlening op het snijvlak van Zorg en ICT; Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau; Je communiceert helder en overtuigend in het Nederlands, mondeling en schriftelijk. Wat je van ons mag verwachten Bij Beter Healthcare kom je terecht in een werkomgeving die draait om groei, vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je kunt rekenen op: Een goed salaris dat we bepalen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring; Sterke secundaire voorwaarden, zoals een leaseauto, bonusregeling, pensioen, laptop en telefoon; Een rol met echte impact: jij opent de deuren waardoor Beter Healthcare kan groeien en de zorg kan verbeteren; Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invloed op onze commerciële koers; Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel commercieel als inhoudelijk; Kennisgroepen, intervisies en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om continu te blijven leren; Interactieve kwartaalbijeenkomsten met collega's op inspirerende locaties; Een hecht team van gedreven healthcare consultants dat altijd met je meedenkt; Een actieve personeelsvereniging voor wie het leuk vindt om samen dingen te ondernemen; Heel veel plezier in een prachtig team. Over Beter Healthcare Beter Healthcare is een consultancybureau op het snijvlak van zorg en ICT. We ondersteunen zorgorganisaties bij de digitalisering van hun processen en dragen zo bij aan een toekomstbestendige zorg. We zijn al met zo'n 100 IT healthcare specialisten en we groeien hard: niet als doel op zich, maar omdat onze klanten ons nodig hebben en onze aanpak werkt. Sinds 2012 helpen we zorgorganisaties met advies, projectmanagement en beheer. Onze kracht is dat we niet alleen adviseren, maar ook samen met klanten oplossingen succesvol implementeren. Onze consultants kennen de zorg van binnenuit, en dat maakt echt het verschil. Beter Healthcare is onderdeel van IG&H, een toonaangevend adviesbureau dat verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor de resultaten van zijn werk. Met de eigen ‘Make Strategy Work’-methodologie richt IG&H zich op digitale transformaties. Binnen IG&H Health werken we samen met teams die gespecialiseerd zijn in onder meer strategy consulting, data en AI, security en managed cloudservices. Voel jij een “ja”? description:
Join our mission, join Doctolib! 

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the Patient team in Paris. 

The Patient domain sits at the heart of Doctolib's mission: ensuring everyone has better access to the care they need, receives better care from health professionals, and can actively prevent health problems to improve their wellbeing.

You’ll design the search and recommendation engines behind our health companion, helping 100M patients across Europe instantly navigate to the exact care they need while delivering trusted, curated insights at every step. The retrieval and recommendation architecture you own will directly shape how relevant, fast, and trustworthy that experience is for every one of them.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design and build the production search & recommendation architecture: full retrieval, ranking, reranking pipeline with standard and off-the-shelf components (vector search, semantic retrieval, LLM/managed rerankers).
  • Establish strong baselines first (prompts, RAG, model selection) before reaching for custom ML.
  • Build evaluation and observability into every stage, with offline and online evaluation.
  • Set up the data/event feedback loops that drive iteration and feed deeper ML later.
  • Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality
  • Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability.
  • Partner with ML Engineers and collaborate closely with PMs and SWEs to define, build, and ship AI-powered features that deliver measurable value to users and the business. 


Who you are

Before you read on:  if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You could be our next team mate if you have:

  1. Production deployment: ability to ship algorithms to production (ECS-based service on AWS)
  2. Strong analytical mindset: result-oriented,  patient-first approach
  3. Significant experience as a Software or/and AI engineer shipping search or recommendation systems to production. 
  4. Hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval: ranking,  reranking pipelines and familiar with nDCG, MAP, Recall@k, MRR
  5. AI-engineering proficiency: turning foundation models and off-the-shelf components into production systems: embeddings & vector search, semantic retrieval, RAG, LLM-based or managed rerankers (e.g. Vertex AI). You can succeed without training a model from scratch
  6. Architecture-first approach: you build the system, baselines, evals, and feedback loops with standard tooling before reaching for custom ML, and know when to partner with ML Engineers to break a ceiling
  7. Evaluation & observability built into every stage (retrieval, ranker, reranker) — offline and online eval, A/B testing, position-bias handling, monitoring
  8. Production deployment — ability to ship reliable, low-latency services to production (hundreds-of-ms SLAs), with care for data quality and long-term maintainability

 

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Experience at a B2C marketplace (e-commerce, hospitality, travel)
  • Additional ML methodologies: pattern mining, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference
  • Have experience with search engines or information retrieval concepts
  • Have exposure to learning-to-rank or feature engineering (for breaking ceilings later, alongside ML Engineers)
  • Have experience in a healthcare or other regulated domain (GDPR / HDS)

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single, fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.
  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.
  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.
  • We also invest in open, applied AI research. For example, our DoctoBERT project introduces open-source medical language models trained for French clinical text, with applications in named entity recognition, classification, and retrieval. Read the DoctoBERT practical guide to learn more about how we bring deep AI research into practical healthcare applications.
Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children
  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT
  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib
  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class
  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription
  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth
  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave, and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib
  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

 

The interview process 

  • A first interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team
  • A coding interview
  • An agentics system design 
  • A behavioural interview 
  • Reference check 

 

Job details

  • Permanent position
  • Full Time 
  • Workplace: Levallois
  • Start date : As soon as possible

 

 

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process. 

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: Germany l France l Italy l Netherlands. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com to exercise your rights.

description: About Peec AI Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win. We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, that went from $0 to $15M ARR in 18 months, with a 100+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our New York office. About the role Peec AI is building the data plane for AI visibility: millions of chats, scrapes, citations, sources, model responses, and customer-facing insights running through a fast-moving backend. This role is for an engineer who wants to own the systems behind that. You will not just add endpoints or close tickets. You will make our scraping, chat-processing, source-ingestion, and analytics infrastructure more reliable, cheaper, faster, and easier for the rest of the team to reason about. The best fit looks like someone who can debug a provider outage in the morning, design a better queueing model before lunch, ship a TypeScript service change in the afternoon, and write the postmortem or follow-up ticket clearly enough that the next engineer immediately knows what to do. We are especially interested in people who have built or operated systems with real constraints: rate limits, flaky third-party APIs, queues, webhooks, retries, distributed locks, data migrations, observability gaps, customer pressure, and cost ceilings. What we’re looking for 5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering experience in a production environment. Deep hands-on TypeScript experience. We run TypeScript services on Bun, and we care about people who can design clean, reliable backend systems rather than only write application code. Strong understanding of queues, workers, retries, rate limits, idempotency, distributed locks, webhooks, and failure handling. Experience operating systems under real production pressure: incidents, provider outages, customer escalations, noisy alerts, slow dependencies, and incomplete data. Comfort with cloud-native infrastructure. Our stack includes GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Redis, Postgres, Firestore, ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry. Ability to debug across layers: application code, logs, metrics, queues, provider APIs, databases, network behaviour, and deployment state. Product-minded judgement. You can separate internal detail from customer-safe explanation, and you understand when a “small infra change” has customer, security, or cost implications. High ownership and low ego. Bring back customer and market insights to influence our roadmap and go‑to‑market.

Strong technical background across infrastructure and data: storage, compute, databases, networking, virtualisation and/or cloud‑native architectures.

Solid experience with data management and storage technologies, and how they support mission‑critical workloads in Automotive and Manufacturing.

description:
Purpose of Position

Awin's Legal team advises the group on its legal rights and obligations across a global affiliate and partnership network. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be a trusted, hands-on partner to our commercial, product and leadership teams, leading complex negotiations, supporting M&A and strategic transactions, and helping the business grow across Europe, the UK, the US and beyond. You will report directly to the General Counsel.

We are looking for a pragmatic, business-enabling lawyer who enjoys solving problems, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is excited about how AI is changing both our industry and the way legal teams work. If you enjoy working across cultures and jurisdictions, join us full-time in one of our hubs, London or Berlin, or work from another country where Awin has an office – you can choose.

Key Tasks

  • Leading the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value commercial agreements with advertisers, publishers, agencies, technology partners and vendors, including MSAs, SaaS and platform terms, partnership agreements, DPAs and NDAs
  • Acting as the go-to legal partner for commercial teams across regions, giving consistent, risk-weighted and business-focused advice that helps close deals
  • Advising on cross-jurisdictional corporate, commercial, competition, intellectual property and regulatory matters under EU, UK, US and other international legal frameworks
  • Supporting M&A and strategic transactions end to end, from due diligence and transaction documents to corporate approvals and post-merger integration
  • Managing disputes, litigation and third-party information requests such as subpoenas, together with external counsel
  • Working with the Privacy team on the commercial and contractual side of data protection, including GDPR, UK GDPR, US state privacy laws and other regimes
  • Shaping how Legal uses AI: introducing AI tools and workflows that make the team more efficient, and advising the business on the legal aspects of AI, including the EU AI Act
  • Improving templates, playbooks and legal processes, and delivering practical training to non-lawyers

Skills & Expertise

  • Qualified as a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales and/or admitted to practise as an attorney in a US state
  • 5+ years' post-qualification experience, ideally in-house in an international business or at a law firm handling comparable commercial work
  • Strong track record in complex commercial negotiations, ideally in affiliate or performance marketing, or in a related sector such as tech, SaaS, AdTech or e-commerce; experience with US commercial contracts, litigation, subpoenas and dispute resolution is a plus
  • Solid M&A experience, including due diligence, transaction documentation and post-closing integration
  • Working knowledge of data protection laws such as GDPR, UK GDPR and US state privacy laws is an advantage
  • Native or native-level English, with excellent drafting and communication skills and the ability to explain complex legal, technical and business matters clearly to non-lawyers; additional languages such as Spanish, French or Portuguese are a plus
  • A keen interest in AI and confidence using AI tools in your daily work, with an eye for how they can make legal work faster and better; knowledge of AI regulation and governance, such as the EU AI Act, is a plus
  • A pragmatic, hands-on and open-minded approach with a business-enabling, can-do mindset
  • Strong organisation and prioritisation skills: you manage several matters at once, work independently and keep quality high under tight deadlines and constant change; experience with contract management systems, Asana or other legal tools is welcome
  • A collaborative team player who builds strong relationships across functions and regions

 

Our Offer
  • Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
  • Flexi-Office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid working model, designed to foster collaboration, trust, and autonomy.
  • Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace at home.
  • Pension: We make regular contributions to support your retirement savings.
  • Private Medical Insurance: Comprehensive coverage for a range of health, vision and dental treatments.
  • Electric Vehicle & Cycle to Work Schemes: Save on commuting costs through tax-efficient schemes for electric vehicle leasing and bike purchase.
  • Workplace Nursery Benefit: Save on childcare costs through a salary sacrifice scheme with tax and National Insurance savings.
In addition, you’ll benefit from our global offering, including health and wellbeing initiatives, learning and development via Awin Academy, and peer-to-peer recognition programmes.

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. Learn more at axelspringer.com/en/, and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why  

Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.

Help people find their next home with absolute certainty.

Your team

Collaborate deeply. Design with absolute purpose.

  • Strong product thinking and problem framing skills.
  • Excellent interaction and visual design craft.
  • Experience in marketplaces, search or discovery products.
  • Experience running discovery and validating ideas.
  • Confidence working with data, metrics and experiments.
  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers and product managers.
  • A portfolio showing not only what you designed – but why.

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!

  • Gym membership discount with GoVital or OneFit.
  • Dutch/English classes budget.

  • Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.

description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

 

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value.

Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execution (blogs, webinar outlines, video scripts, etc). Our team is full of people who crave impact and independence - if you are seeking a role with narrow scope where you run a defined playbook, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Actively partner with and teach product managers to define product value, messaging, and go-to-market strategy, from competitive positioning to sales enablement collateral.
  • Partner with product management, engineering and various go-to-market functions to create materials that help customers evaluate and adopt our products: reference architectures, implementation guides, detailed product information and more.
  • Own customer lifecycle campaigns (competitive positioning, retention, upsell/cross-sell) to strategically shape marketing programs and drive growth across the entire customer journey.
  • Conduct market and customer research to understand pain points, competition and opportunities.
  • Teach go-to-market and sales teams our products’ capabilities and the value they provide, deliver training and enablement, ensure customer facing teams are able to effectively engage with customers, partners, and prospects.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience (product marketing, solutions marketing, product management)
  • Experience with marketing and selling to a technical audience
  • A passion for open source, cloud native, and infrastructure technologies 
  • Proven ability to take on complex projects and efficiently drive them from start to finish
  • Ability to clearly articulate the value of technical products to customers and sellers alike
  • Experience leading product or feature launches autonomously as well as part of a team
  • Experience working with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate messaging and workflows
  • Comfort working with a variety of internal and external stakeholders in complicated processes
  • Strong product and technical curiosity that translate to clear packaging, positioning, and messaging
  • Demonstrated quantitative analytical skills for analyzing campaign performance, evaluating lifecycle metrics, and making data-driven recommendations.
  • Exceptional writing and communication skills
  • A high “say-do” ratio in executing and delivering impact 

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 97,034 - EUR 116,441. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. 
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

description:
About the role

We are looking for a Senior Reporting Specialist to join our Finance team. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in accounting, financial reporting, and internal controls to support the Group Reporting team's consolidation, disclosure, and financial compliance. In addition, this role will play a critical part in the Group's key strategic finance initiatives by partnering closely with cross-functional teams and external professional advisors.

Your Responsibilities

As a Senior Reporting Specialist, you will be a key contributor to developing the Group's reporting framework and advancing major strategic finance initiatives

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Strategic Finance Project Support: Full involvement in financial work related to major capital markets and strategic finance projects, including but not limited to audit working paper and materials preparation, financial data organization, external audit coordination, and due diligence responses

• Financial Report Preparation and Compliance: Responsible for the preparation and analysis of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring strict adherence to internationally recognized accounting standards (such as US GAAP, IFRS) and other relevant standards. In addition, you will be responsible for preparing and filing periodic Group financial reports as required by relevant regulatory authorities

• External Professional Liaison: Deeply engage with and coordinate external auditors, tax advisors, and other advisor teams. Effectively communicate significant accounting matters to support the successful execution of the Group's major finance initiatives and ongoing compliance thereafter

• Group Accounting Policy and Accounting Standard Updates: Streamline and harmonize the Group's accounting policies, assess the impact of accounting standard updates on the company's business and financial statements, and provide professional accounting treatment solutions

• Consolidated Financial Statements and Business Analysis: Responsible for or assist in the preparation of consolidated financial statements for the Group, with familiarity in financial statement conversions across different accounting standards. Participate in financial analysis and provide financial insights into company decision-making

• Special Accounting Matters Handling: Prepare professional accounting memos for new business initiatives or significant accounting matters, and provide corresponding accounting treatment recommendations

• Internal Control Optimization and Internal Control Audit: Drive the continuous optimization and upgrade of the company's internal control systems, financial processes, and policies to enhance financial operational efficiency and compliance

Your Profile

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Accounting, Financial Management, Economics, or a related financial discipline

  • Wirtschaftsprüfer, AICPA (American CPA), ACCA certificate, or other equivalent qualifications, with all examination sections passed

  • 3-5 years of audit experience from an international Big Four accounting firm, or relevant Group financial reporting experience at a multinational listed company

  • Proven experience in participating in listing or major capital markets audit projects, as well as establishing corporate internal control systems and supporting or conducting internal control audits

  • Experience in financial roles within robotics or manufacturing companies is a plus

  • Fluent oral communication skills in English, and able to independently review and draft complex English audit and financial documents

 

 

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. 

This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!

We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Are you passionate about Privacy Protections and the Open Web? Do you want to ship software to a large user base? Do you want your contributions to have a positive impact on the world?  Do you want to advance current browser architecture to make the web a safer place for users?

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and restricted. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to support the Privacy Team to advance the Firefox Web Platform.

What you'll do:
  • Implement Privacy-improving, anti-tracking and threat intelligence protection into the Firefox web browser to mitigate user tracking and phishing.
  • Implement architectural improvements into Gecko, the browser engine underlying Firefox.
  • Build performant, low-latency, and maintainable C++, JavaScript and Rust code 
  • Work as part of a geographically distributed team in an asynchronous manner (mostly Europe and US-East).
What you'll bring:
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related program; or equivalent work experience.
  • At least 4 years of experience with programming in C++ and Rust, with a strong background in memory safety, multi-threaded system architecture, or raw data stream manipulation.
  • Proven ability to onboard quickly, deliver and improve complex software projects.
  • Proven track record of independently scoping and landing complex features within tight release windows.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can validate your progress and decisions and communicate them clearly.
Bonus Points:
  • You have already contributed to the Mozilla mission and the codebase.
  • Experience working within the browser space (Gecko, Chromium, WebKit) or web engine runtime abstractions.
  • Experience or high interest in designing or leveraging ML pipelines to automate internal developer workflows.
  • Deep understanding of web architecture, the privacy/security model of the web, and client-side data structures.
  • Knowledge of basic statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency with Python and SQL.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday

description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role: 

The Senior Specialist, QA will provide operational leadership and quality oversight for the review, approval and release-readiness of clinical and commercial product batches. 

The role is responsible for ensuring that batch documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, and compliant with applicable GMP requirements, approved procedures and regulatory commitments before submission to QA for final disposition or QP certification. The person will coordinate batch-release activities across Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and external manufacturing partners, ensuring that issues are identified, escalated and resolved in a timely manner. The position will also lead process improvements, support inspection readiness and promote high standards of data integrity and Good Documentation Practice across the batch-release process. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Batch Review and Release Readiness 
  • Coordinate the end-to-end QA review of executed batch manufacturing, packaging, testing and release documentation for IMP and Commercial biological batch records. 
  • Coordinate the preparation and collation of batch documentation required for final batch disposition or QP certification from internal and external sources. 
  • Verify that batch records are complete, accurate, and compliant with approved procedures, specifications and applicable GMP requirements. 
  • Confirm that relevant deviations, investigations, change controls, CAPAs, and laboratory results have been appropriately assessed and approved before release. 
  • Identify documentation gaps, discrepancies and potential compliance risks, and coordinate their timely resolution. 
  • Maintain oversight of batch-release priorities, review status, outstanding actions, and planned release dates. 
  • Escalate critical issues or potential delays to Quality leadership and relevant stakeholders. 
  • Ensure that batch-release documentation is appropriately archived and readily retrievable electronically. 

 

  • Quality Systems and Compliance: 
  • Ensure batch-release activities are performed in accordance with current GMP, Good Documentation Practice, data-integrity principles, and internal procedures. 
  • Support the effective operation of quality systems associated with deviations, CAPAs, change controls, document control, and training. 
  • Review and approve relevant quality documents, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, checklists, and batch-release procedures. 
  • Maintain controlled documentation and ensure that current approved versions are available to relevant personnel. 
  • Support periodic reviews of procedures and identify opportunities to strengthen compliance and operational effectiveness. 
  • Promote the appropriate use of electronic quality and document management systems. 
  • Act as a subject-matter expert for batch documentation, release-readiness and associated document-control processes for all batch release activities. 
  • Internal Team Coordination (EU QA) 
  • Provide day-to-day leadership and technical guidance to QA batch reviewers and supporting personnel. 
  • Plan and allocate batch-review activities according to business priorities, product demand, and release timelines. 
  • Monitor team workload, quality metrics, and completion of assigned activities. 
  • Develop and deliver training in Good Documentation Practice, batch-record review and relevant quality-system processes. 
  • Support onboarding and qualifications of new QA team members. 
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and continuous-improvement culture within the QA function. 

 

  • External Team Collaboration: 
  • Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality Control / CMC, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Supply and other relevant functions to support timely batch release. 
  • Coordinate with all Summit CMOs, testing laboratories and service providers to obtain missing documents and resolve release-related queries. 
  • Communicate batch status, risks, priorities and outstanding actions clearly to internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Support changes affecting batch documentation or release processes. 
  • Participate in cross-functional meetings concerning batch disposition, documentation, readiness, and supply continuity internally. 

 

  • Inspection Readiness and Continuous Improvement 
  • Maintain batch-release processes and supporting records in a continuous state of inspection of readiness. 
  • Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, internal audits, and supplier audits. 
  • Retrieve and present batch documentation and quality-system records during audits and inspections. 
  • Track batch-review metrics, recurring documentation issues, cycle times, and overdue actions. 
  • Analyse trends and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, right-first-time performance and compliance. 
  • Lead or contribute to Lean and process-optimization initiatives within the batch-release function. 
  • Support the implementation and enhancement of electronic quality, document management and reporting systems. 

Qualifications and Experience 

  • Essential 
  • Recognized qualification in Quality, Pharmaceutical Science, Life Sciences, Engineering or related discipline. 
  • Significant experience in Quality Assurance within a pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical or similarly regulated manufacturing environment – preferably in Biologic manufacturing, Packaging and Labelling environments.  
  • Practical experience reviewing executed batch records and supporting batch disposition or QP certification activities. 
  • Knowledge of GMP, Good Documentation Practice, and data-integrity requirements. 
  • Experience working with deviations, investigations, CAPAs, and change controls. 
  • Experience using electronic quality, document management and other enterprise-systems - systems such as MasterControl, NetSuite, Veeva Vault, TrackWise, SAP or equivalent platforms. 
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple priorities and deliver against critical release timelines. 
  • Experience supporting the release of medicinal products or investigational medicinal products. 
  • Experience working with contract manufacturing organizations and external testing laboratories 

 

  • Key Competencies 
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy 
  • Sound quality and compliance judgement 
  • Leadership and team coordination 
  • Effective prioritization and workload management 
  • Problem-solving and risk-based decision-making 
  • Clear communication and stakeholder management 
  • Audit and inspection readiness 
  • Data integrity and information governance 
  • Process improvement and operational efficiency 
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
